name: Applystead API
description: Search Applystead's job data and add applications to your queue from your own code. Create keys on the API page in Applystead and send one as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Calls are paid from your prepaid balance; Premium members pay 40% less. Every response says what it charged (charged_usd) and what is left (balance_usd). Applications you add are refunded automatically if they are never sent. Webhooks tell your own HTTPS endpoint, or a Discord or Slack channel, as soon as one of your applications is sent: free with Premium, otherwise priced per delivery.
